p.PURPOSE: Prove that a central session can derive the same complete goal from files alone, reject ambiguity and stale authority, and carry candidates plus distant work without an LLM call.

facts.CASE-GOLDEN: Render the shipped one-campaign fixture and compare exact GOAL.md bytes to its non-converted golden `expected/GOAL.txt`.
facts.CASE-AMBIGUOUS: Remove `goal_node` while two top-level campaigns are open: `GOAL_NODE_AMBIGUOUS`, no output mutation.
facts.CASE-STALE: Change separately plan bytes, revision, selected node and profile; each makes the old marker stale. Change only interaction mode; it remains current.
facts.CASE-STABLE: Render twice from identical bytes: both outputs are byte-identical and contain no time/model/session data. The Claude condition is one line and at most 4000 UTF-16 units.
facts.CASE-CANDIDATE: Candidate appears under Current candidates and Remaining route, never Accepted boundary.
facts.CASE-CUSTODY: Worker, different holder and `offering` each diagnose but leave a sentinel GOAL.md byte-identical.
facts.CASE-MOVED: Move the plan between snapshot and rename twice: `GOAL_INPUT_MOVED`, no partial/temporary output remains.
facts.CASE-CLAUDE-BOUND: Grow candidates and direct children across the cap: deterministic full-entry → ids-only → exact `+N more in GOAL.md` fallback, never arbitrary truncation; mandatory-base overflow refuses only the adapter.

p.PASS: All eight cases pass; package check is clean; a real long campaign goal includes its accepted frontier, candidate, complete distant route and final gates, and survives compact/resume without chat context.
